items.rationale: Policy 5.2.6(b) covers costs of inspecting and assessing the damage to determine cause and extent, up to EUR 3,000 per event. Reference Case 2 (diagnostic inspection, t between 60 and 84) and Case 18 (damage assessment, t >= 221) show that for a full property assessment, a moderate but not high threshold applies.

items.description: Indoor leak detection incl. measurement technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.6(a) covers leak location (acoustic, thermographic, etc.) and technician time up to EUR 1,000 per event. Reference Case 2 (diagnostic inspection, t between 60 and 84) and Case 16 (thermal imaging, t below 57) suggest a moderate threshold for a single visit with technician and vehicle.

items.description: Floor covering removal incl. linoleum and skirting, surface preparation and construction-waste disposal
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(a) and (c) cover removal of affected finishes and necessary substrate prep; 5.2.1 covers debris removal. However, 7.1.10 applies: as the leak was due to gradual ageing, only the pipe repair and diagnostic costs are covered, not moisture damage or associated works. Reference Case 2 and policy 7.1.10: t = 0.
Policy 7.1.8(b) excludes contractor provisioning and catering as not a repair cost.

items.description: Technical drying (large-area, cavity and borehole) incl. labour, dust protection and kitchen disinfection
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10: for gradual pipe ageing, only pipe repair and diagnostic costs are covered, not moisture damage or drying. Reference Case 2: drying and associated works are not indemnified for gradual leaks.
Policy 7.1.7(b) and 7.1.10: even if drying were covered, separately metered utility charges for drying are not indemnified. For gradual leaks, drying is not covered at all.
